nphi.title: Strengthening Biosecurity in Southeast and Eastern Europe (Biosecurity SEEE)
nphi.with: Georgian NCDC; Bundeswehr Institute of Microbiology; GIZ; BACAC; WHO; US DTRA; ISTC; STCU
nphi.summary: RIVM coordinated needs-based biosafety and biosecurity capacity building, including national assessments, pathogen inventories and train-the-trainer courses in Georgia.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P44 – CBRN preparedness and response enhancement in South East and Eastern Europe
nphi.summary: RIVM led the work package that produced a country report for each of the nine partner countries, plus train-the-trainer materials and exercise guidance, to strengthen how first responders handle CBRN incidents.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P57 – CBRN crime scene forensics in South East and Eastern Europe
nphi.with: SCK CEN (coordinator); Netherlands Forensic Institute; INCC Belgium; Forensic Science Centre Ivan Vučetić; ISEMI
nphi.summary: RIVM led the project, which trained forensic investigators to collect evidence at CBRN incident scenes, wrote procedures, and ran six sub-regional exercises.

nphi.title: SPHERE – Strengthening public health systems in the Western Balkans (GHPP)
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health Albania; National Institute of Public Health Kosovo; Institute of Public Health of Montenegro; Institute of Public Health North Macedonia
nphi.summary: An RKI-implemented GHPP project with four Western Balkan NPHIs on pandemic preparedness, IHR, laboratory diagnostics, surveillance and AMR monitoring. It builds on cooperation that began in 2016.

nphi.title: PACT-PHM – Partnerships for population health metrics capacities and tools
nphi.with: WHO Regional Office for Europe (Denmark); Sciensano (Belgium)
nphi.summary: Builds national capacity to produce burden-of-disease and other population health metrics and embed them in health information systems for policy use.

nphi.title: ECDC MoUs with Serbia, North Macedonia and Ukraine (2025)
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health of Serbia; Institute of Public Health of North Macedonia; Ministry of Health of Ukraine
nphi.summary: In 2025 ECDC signed memoranda of understanding with Serbia's and North Macedonia's institutes of public health and Ukraine's Ministry of Health, alongside those with other enlargement countries, to prepare them for EU integration of…

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 110 – One Health Secure
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); CSIC; IRD; IZS Teramo; AVIA-GIS
nphi.summary: EU CBRN Centres of Excellence project in which Institut Pasteur and Italy's ISS, with veterinary and research partners, help Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel countries prepare for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases through One…

nphi.title: SECID – South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases
nphi.actor: SECID / Institute of Public Health, Albania (SEEHN)
nphi.with: South East European Center for Surveillance and Control of Infectious Diseases (Tirana); South-eastern Europe Health Network (SEEHN); national public health institutes of the region; CORDS network; assisted by US CDC
nphi.summary: Regional centre set up in Tirana in 2013 under SEEHN, linked to Albania's Institute of Public Health, that supports national authorities across South-East Europe on influenza and respiratory-pathogen surveillance, pandemic preparedness…

nphi.title: EMIS-2023 – European MSM internet survey extended to Eastern Europe/Central Asia
nphi.with: Deutsche Aidshilfe (Germany); ECOM – Eurasian Coalition on Health, Rights, Gender and Sexual Diversity; SEE RCN – South Eastern Europe Regional TB and HIV Community Network
nphi.summary: Extended online health and behaviour surveys among MSM to EECA and Western Balkans to strengthen HIV/STI surveillance.

nphi.title: WASP – Western Balkan strategic partnership for health protection
nphi.with: Institute of Public Health (Montenegro); Clinical Center of Montenegro; Institute of Public Health (Albania); Institute for Public Health FBiH (Bosnia and Herzegovina); Public Health Institute Republika Srpska; National Institute of Public Health (Kosovo); Institute of Public Health (North Macedonia); Faculty of Medicine, University of Belgrade; City Institute of Public Health Belgrade (Serbia)
nphi.summary: Built epidemiological preparedness, workforce training and molecular lab capacity against infectious threats in the Western Balkans.

nphi.title: CORRAL – COVID-19 response and recovery alliance for Montenegro and Western Balkans
nphi.with: Charité – Universitätsmedizin Berlin (Germany); Clinical Centre of Montenegro; Institute of Public Health of Montenegro; WHO Country Office Montenegro
nphi.summary: Supported COVID-19 response via lab and genomic surveillance, clinical training, a virtual EOC and a regional field epidemiology network.

nphi.title: EU Initiative on Health Security (2020–2025)
nphi.with: National public health institutes and ministries of health of EU Enlargement and Neighbourhood countries
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded €9 million programme through which ECDC built epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, preparedness and field-epidemiology (MediPIET) capacity in 21 neighbourhood and enlargement countries and integrated them into ECDC…

nphi.title: ECDC IPA6 project – One Health AMR and SARI surveillance in the Western Balkans and Türkiye
nphi.with: National public health institutes of the six Western Balkan beneficiaries and Türkiye
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded ECDC technical assistance (2020–2024) on One Health antimicrobial resistance and enhanced SARI surveillance, bringing Western Balkan and Turkish experts into ECDC networks such as E-SARI-Net as observers.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 075 – MediLabSecure (One Health biological risks in the Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel)
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); IRD; INIA; IZS Teramo; Avia-GIS
nphi.summary: EU-funded network led by Institut Pasteur with Italy's ISS that strengthened laboratories and public health institutions in 22 neighbouring countries to detect and respond to arboviruses and their vectors, including external quality…

nphi.title: GETPrepaReD – Emergency trainings and support for outbreak preparedness
nphi.with: National Institutes of Public Health of Albania, Kosovo, Montenegro and North Macedonia
nphi.summary: Strengthened epidemiological, surveillance and crisis-management capacity in Western Balkan NPHIs.

nphi.title: MediPIET – Mediterranean and Black Sea Programme for Intervention Epidemiology Training
nphi.with: FIIAPP; FCSAI; ECDC (scientific lead); national public health authorities of partner countries
nphi.summary: An EU-initiated field epidemiology fellowship for Mediterranean and Black Sea countries. ISCIII co-implemented it with FIIAPP (2014–2017) and FCSAI (2018–2021); ECDC ran it alone from 2021 to 2025.
